name: Ashtraylor
look: a heavy tortoise whose shell is a chipped ceramic ashtray basin full of ash, butts and glowing embers
entry: Travelers use Ashtraylor's basin-like back to safely extinguish campfires. It absorbs the leftover cinders to harden its stony shell.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
